title: The Lion Who Wouldn't Try
summary: All the animals in the jungle are playing, except the lion. Why won't he join them?
pages:
It was a sunny day in the jungle.
All the animals came out to play.

"Come and play with me, Lion," said Cheetah. "Catch me if you can!"
Zoom, zoom! went Cheetah.
"I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

"Come and play with me, Lion," said Elephant. "Let's throw stones!"
Boom! Boom! went Elephant.
"I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

"Come and play with us, Lion!" said the monkeys. "Who can eat the most bananas?"
Pop! Pop! Pop! went the monkeys.
"I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

"Come and play with me, Lion," said Springbok. "Let's jump high!"
Hop! Hop! Hop! went Springbok.
"I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

"Come and play with me, Lion," said Crocodile. "There's a swimming race!"
Splash! Splash! went Crocodile.
"I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

Elephant and Crocodile had the swimming race without Lion.
Crocodile was faster than Elephant, but every time Crocodile passed him, Elephant tickled him!
Hee, hee, hee! laughed Elephant and Crocodile.
Lion sat all alone, sad, watching Crocodile and Elephant swim.

"Why are you sad, Lion?" asked Mouse.
"Because I don't want to play," said Lion. "I'll lose."

Lion slipped on a banana peel!
Wheeeee! went Lion.
"That looks like fun!" said all the other animals.

Lion played,
and he was happy.
